zh.principle: **协议**：EAP 认证框架（Extensible Authentication Protocol）。EAP 是框架而非某一机制：RFC 3748 §1 定义「This document defines the Extensible Authentication Protocol (EAP), an authentication framework which supports multiple authentication methods.」
zh.why: 可扩展性来自`认证器不必认识方法`：§1 说明「Rather than requiring the authenticator to be updated to support each new authentication method, EAP permits the use of a backend authentication server, which may implement some or all authentication methods, with the authenticator acting as a pass-through for some or all methods and peers.」
zh.used: 透传认证器只做有限的检查与转发：§2.3 规定「Compliant pass-through authenticator implementations MUST by default forward EAP packets of any Type.」而 §2.1 要求一次会话中「the peer and authenticator MUST utilize only one authentication method (Type 4 or greater) within an EAP conversation, after which the authenticator MUST send a Success or Failure packet.」
zh.broken: 框架不承担下层协商与消息承载的安全：§7.11 指出「if the lower layer performs ciphersuite negotiation, it should be understood that EAP does not provide by itself integrity protection of that negotiation.」§2.2 另外禁止把结果与通知消息用于他途：「the Success, Failure, Nak Response(s), and Notification Request/Response messages MUST NOT be used to carry data destined for delivery to other EAP methods.」
zh.history:
RFC 3748 于 2004 年 6 月发布为 Standards Track 并标注「Obsoletes: 2284」；§6.2 说明方法类型空间的稀缺：「The original EAP method Type space has a range from 1 to 255, and is the scarcest resource in EAP, and thus must be allocated with care.Method Types 1-45 have been allocated, with 20 available for re-use.」

en.principle: **Protocol**: Extensible Authentication Protocol (EAP 认证框架). EAP is a framework rather than a mechanism: §1 defines it as "This document defines the Extensible Authentication Protocol (EAP), an authentication framework which supports multiple authentication methods."
en.why: Extensibility comes from the authenticator not needing to know the methods: §1 explains "Rather than requiring the authenticator to be updated to support each new authentication method, EAP permits the use of a backend authentication server, which may implement some or all authentication methods, with the authenticator acting as a pass-through for some or all methods and peers."
en.used:
A pass-through authenticator checks little and forwards: §2.3 states "Compliant pass-through authenticator implementations MUST by default forward EAP packets of any Type." while §2.1 requires that "the peer and authenticator MUST utilize only one authentication method (Type 4 or greater) within an EAP conversation, after which the authenticator MUST send a Success or Failure packet."

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records. If versions, regions or institutions define the name differently, the differences stay side by side.
en.broken: The framework does not secure lower-layer negotiation or carry extra data: §7.11 warns "if the lower layer performs ciphersuite negotiation, it should be understood that EAP does not provide by itself integrity protection of that negotiation." and §2.2 forbids reuse of result packets: "the Success, Failure, Nak Response(s), and Notification Request/Response messages MUST NOT be used to carry data destined for delivery to other EAP methods."
en.history: RFC 3748 is a June 2004 Standards Track document carrying “Obsoletes: 2284”. Section 6.2 describes the scarce identifier space: "The original EAP method Type space has a range from 1 to 255, and is the scarcest resource in EAP, and thus must be allocated with care. Method Types 1-45 have been allocated, with 20 available for re-use."

zh: 认证器：转发或本地执行 EAP 方法的一端。
pass-through：认证器只转发包、不解释方法层。
Type 字段：标识具体 EAP 方法。
canned Success：链路刚建立就发出的 Success 包，默认必须静默丢弃。
en: Authenticator: the end that forwards or locally runs EAP methods.
Pass-through: the authenticator forwards packets without interpreting the method layer.
Type field: identifies the specific EAP method.
Canned Success: a Success packet sent as soon as the link is up, which by default MUST be silently discarded.
